annotation.title_clean: 中华人民共和国行政复议法实施条例
annotation.title_en: Regulations for the Implementation of the Administrative Reconsideration Law of the People's Republic of China
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 中华人民共和国国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.summary_en: State Council Order No. 836 promulgating the revised Regulations implementing China's Administrative Reconsideration Law, effective 1 July 2026. It details scope, applicants, filing, jurisdiction, acceptance, hearing, evidence, decisions and supervision of administrative reconsideration. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Revised regulation takes effect 1 July 2026, replacing the 2007 version.
Reconsideration organs review legality and appropriateness of administrative acts.
Online reconsideration filings have equal legal effect to offline ones.
Defines scope, standing, time limits, jurisdiction and acceptance rules.
Sets decision types, administrative agreement and compensation cases, and supervision.
